ink.$description: Ink — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

raw-linen.$description: Raw Linen — Page canvas and card backgrounds — warm off-white, the signature surface that distinguishes this system from generic white SaaS

white.$description: White — Elevated card surfaces, badge fills, inverse text on dark buttons

fog.$description: Fog — Muted helper text, secondary dividers, disabled labels

blush.$description: Blush — Accent surface wash — hero image tint, product photo backdrop, soft highlight zones

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Darkest UI surface — footer dark bands, chat widget shell, overlaid panels

sage-leaf.$description: Sage Leaf — Signature accent — top announcement bar, hairline decorative borders, icon strokes, functional green; the brand's quiet living color

heritage-blue.$description: Heritage Blue — Primary action — filled buttons, link underlines, selected states; dusty mid-blue carries trust without corporate coldness

midnight-forest.$description: Midnight Forest — Dark filled buttons (hero CTA), deep green-black for high-emphasis actions; warmer than charcoal, more sophisticated than black

ember.$description: Ember — NEW badges, notification dots, star ratings, cart count bubble — vivid warm orange used sparingly as functional punctuation

foundersgrotesk.$description: Workhorse sans for navigation, product cards, badges, body text, buttons, inputs, icons. The 0.1–0.15em letter-spacing on 13–15px sizes is the signature tracking pattern for uppercase labels (NEW, ORGANIC COTTON, Shop Underwear).

ttramillaslight.$description: Editorial serif for hero headline, subhead, and body excerpts. Tight -0.01em tracking and low contrast strokes create a quiet, literary feel that contrasts the geometric sans.

gtstandard-m.$description: Specialty text at 17px with 0.025em tracking — used for minimal secondary copy, not a primary face
